recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, high-contrast black and white photograph of a man in mid-air, performing a dynamic jump with limbs extended diagonally. The subject wears studded leather attire and is set against a stark, seamless white background, framed by vibrant, angled sans-serif typography that follows the lines of his movement.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's diagonal limbs dictate the angle of the typography
High-contrast black subject against a pure white void
Primary colors in text provide a sharp counterpoint to the monochrome figure
The center of gravity is suspended, creating a sense of weightlessness
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no horizon line
High-contrast lighting on the subject's skin and leather texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale figure occupying the middle 60% of the frame, limbs extending toward the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face and afro, positioned slightly above the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A diagonal 'X' shape formed by the limbs, leading the eye from the top-left text down to the bottom-right leg, and from the bottom-left arm up to the top-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the figure to emphasize the silhouette and kinetic energy.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast in the center; high saturation, medium value in the peripheral text.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone grays in the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying colors and angles to create rhythm.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and circular counters.
Provides the necessary geometric purity and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a person with an afro in a dynamic mid-air jump, wearing studded black leather, against a seamless pure white studio background. Ensure the lighting creates sharp highlights on the leather.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold geometric sans-serif text in the corners. One word in vibrant green at a 45-degree angle in the top left; a name in orange-red at a -30-degree angle in the top right, followed by smaller gray text on the same angled baseline.

verificationChecks: Is the subject's pose dynamic and diagonal?
Is the text angled to match the energy of the jump?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between subject and background
Verify typography is angled and not horizontal
Ensure no gray mid-tones in the background
Confirm the subject appears to be floating/jumping
recipe.reuseFormula: Dynamic [Subject] + High-Contrast Monochrome + [Diagonal Geometric Typography] + [Vibrant Accent Color] + [Seamless White Void]
